summary: Idaho has official Vote Idaho 2024 county presidential result rows, official Vote Idaho county U.S. House comparison rows, official Idaho Secretary of State county turnout and registration denominator rows, Census county geometry, county equipment context, and official Idaho SOS 2012/2016/2020 county historical presidential baseline rows. The historical baseline CSV is active in native staging for county-level flip/join context. Active staging still lacks precinct/local reporting-unit result rows, precinct geometry, and normalized audit/CVR/incident/correction/recount/litigation records.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Idaho Secretary of State Vote Idaho official 2024 General Election county XML result endpoints
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: idahoOfficialCountyXml via scripts/normalize_id_official_results.py and etl/state-configs/id.json certifiedResults
caveats: The Vote Idaho archive marks the 2024 General Election results official and reports 44 of 44 counties fully reported.
Five stale county XML endpoints use Vote Idaho official map Trump/Harris values plus public county-table Other totals that cite the same Vote Idaho archive.
Rejected write-in administrative rows are excluded from candidate totals.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Idaho Secretary of State Vote Idaho official 2024 General Election congressional map results
caveats: U.S. House is district-based, not a single statewide comparison contest.
Ada County is split across congressional districts on the source page and is aggregated back to county scope.
The current public artifact supports county-level President-versus-U.S.-House review rows, not precinct scatter plots.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: U.S. EAC 2024 EAVS V2 Idaho county turnout benchmark
caveats: Retained as benchmark context after state-native Idaho county turnout was loaded.
The Idaho SOS county turnout workbook matches EAC ballots cast and registered-voter totals in every county.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Idaho Secretary of State 2024 General Election county turnout workbook
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: normalizedTurnoutCsv via scripts/normalize-id-turnout.mjs and etl/state-configs/id.json turnout
caveats: Total Registered Voters equals Registration at Cutoff plus Election Day Registrations in every county.
The official raw precinct turnout workbook is retained as a source lead, but active Idaho review rows remain county-level President-versus-U.S. House rows.
This turnout replacement does not change result, review, or advisory indicator semantics.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: U.S. Census TIGERweb Idaho county geography
caveats: County geometry supports county map joins only; precinct boundary geometry is not loaded.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Verified Voting Verifier Idaho 2024 equipment context
caveats: Equipment context is not a vote, turnout, audit, CVR, incident, correction, recount, or litigation source and does not prove every precinct in a county used one identical configuration.

loadedArtifacts.sourceTitle: Idaho Secretary of State official 2012/2016/2020 county presidential archive and statistics tables
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: Collected by scripts/collect-id-historical-baseline.py as historicalPresidentialCsv-compatible CSV; active through etl/state-configs/id.json historicalBaselines.
caveats: Rows are contextual county historical baselines only, not 2024 certified data.

The 2020 rows use the official Idaho SOS statistics county table because the county abstract ZIP mixes XLSX and PDF-only county abstracts; the parser cross-checks major-party totals against XLSX abstracts where available and reconciles all 2020 rows to official statewide totals.
Historical rows are county-level only and do not add precinct historical coverage.

stateNativeTurnout.details: Official county turnout workbook reports Registration at Cutoff, Election Day Registrations, Total Registered Voters, Ballots Cast, and Voter Turnout. The normalizer verifies county workbook rows against raw precinct-stat county totals and retained EAC benchmark rows.
stateNativeTurnout.remainingNeed: Use official raw precinct turnout only after same-grain precinct/local President and comparison rows are collected, or keep precinct turnout documented as a source lead.

precinctOrLocalReviewRows.requestNeed: Official precinct or local reporting-unit President rows plus same-grain U.S. House or another statewide comparison contest before upgrading advisory coverage below county level.

precinctBoundaryGeometry.requestNeed: Official statewide precinct boundary geometry or a precinct-to-county/reporting-unit crosswalk if subcounty map overlays are required.

historicalBaselines.caveat: Official 2012 and 2016 county presidential archive tables and the official 2020 SOS county statistics page are normalized into data/id-historical-presidential-baseline.csv. The 2020 statistics rows include named third-party and aggregate write-in columns, reconcile to official statewide totals, and are active in native staging for county-level historical context.

postElectionAudit.requestNeed: Official 2024 Idaho post-election audit selection and outcome artifacts, if published or obtainable, with county/reporting-unit grain and discrepancy fields.

cvrAvailability.requestNeed: Official county or SOS CVR availability records, public-records request responses, or documented nonavailability notes before claiming CVR coverage.

incidentsCorrectionsRecountsLitigation.requestNeed: Official incident, correction, recount, election-contest, or litigation records for the 2024 general election, normalized only after authoritative source collection.

displayApiCaveats.advisoryUse: Idaho advisory indicators use county-level official President-versus-U.S.-House review rows. U.S. House is district-based, and the review rows are screening/context signals only, not claims of fraud or misconduct. State-native county turnout is loaded for turnout context only.
displayApiCaveats.productionPromotion: Not authorized from worker branch; no native:promote or native:counts run.
displayApiCaveats.historicalUse: Official 2012/2016/2020 county historical rows are active for historical context and county flip/join coverage. They are contextual baselines, not 2024 certified results or advisory findings.

gaps.remainingRisk: Official raw precinct turnout exists, but active Idaho review rows remain county-level, so precinct turnout is not active for same-grain advisory screening.
Current advisory coverage is county-level only.
Public map joins remain county geometry only.
No normalized audit selection/outcome rows are available.
No CVR availability table or CVR dataset is available.
Official county historical baselines are active for 2012/2016/2020, but no precinct/local historical rows are loaded.
